blocks.heading: Fireflies.ai cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Fireflies.ai against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, agent / app builder) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Free storage (400 min/team) burns down fast; transcription unlimited is not unlimited retention. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want auto-join transcripts across Zoom/Meet/Teams requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Conversation intelligence and team analytics unlock on Business

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: SSO, HIPAA, and private storage are Enterprise-only

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not a general LLM assistant or voice studio

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Bot-join UX is polarising in some meetings — Chrome extension is the alternative capture path
